record.question: If the cost of 12 pens is equal to the cost of 8 pencils, and the cost of one pencil is ₹6, what is the cost of one pen?
record.explanation: Eight pencils at Rs.6 cost Rs.48. Twelve pens cost the same, so one pen costs 48/12=Rs.4. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
